findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - one selected item merges while another stops for a review decision, and the user reruns the same command after resolving it.
The preflight requires a checkout or published branch for every name. A successful merge normally deletes both for the first item (`src/forge/merge.py:291-296` and `:303-325`), so `close._worktree` refuses it as not started before the remaining item reaches the queue. The merged item is still known on the default branch (`src/forge/task.py:614-616`); `--all` can continue with the remaining item.
findings.title: Allow a partially completed named batch to resume

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a Forge upgrade has merged, the selected ready worktrees use the new release, and the local main checkout has not been fast-forwarded.
The initial pin check succeeds when the command starts in a selected worktree, but this call switches to the main checkout and starts each member from there (`src/forge/land.py:354-357` and `:831-838`). Each child then reads main's old pin and `repo.check_pin` refuses because the member's checkout pins the installed release (`src/forge/repo.py:985-1011`). The combined check can finish before the train stops without merging its members.
findings.title: Keep named batches working when the main checkout has an older pin

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a member's workflow is restarted through the GitHub API with debug logging.
The earlier `--method POST` example is now caught, but `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/123/rerun -F enable_debug_logging=true` also sends a POST: [GitHub CLI infers POST from fields](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_api), and [the rerun endpoint accepts that field](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs#re-run-a-workflow). There is no separate `POST` argument for this assertion to find, and the fixture accepts generic API calls (`tests/test_setup.py:224`). A member rerun in that form can therefore leave the named proof passing.
findings.title: Gate: test_1_two_named_items_are_tested_together_once_and_the_third_is_left_alone

stop.reason: Owner chose: fix the resume after a partial named batch; accept the older-main-pin case like --all (filed); drop the rare API-rerun test form

why: forge land --all takes every item in close, including items the owner has on hold, so a team cannot land a chosen set of Ready items with one combined check; merging them one by one re-runs the combined test after each merge (25-40 min each at a client). Owner, 18 Nov 2026: fix it and release fast.
